pm-ryan: quick rollcall for the streaming resilience bridge. goal: own reconnects, partial-chunk regressions, and timeouts until we have 14 clean days. short notes and owners below.

Sanjay: i'll take reconnect lib + client-side backoff. will implement exp backoff + jitter and ensure KV resume token safety. ticket RED-9501.

Maria: i'll add a 'partial_chunk_detected' metric, a Prom alert, and a small dashboard panel by region. ticket RED-9502.

Ken: i'll produce a one-page runbook (detect -> automated retry -> fallback -> escalation) and own canary steps. ticket RED-9503.

pm-ryan: two quick asks: 1) add acceptance criteria and tests to each RED ticket today; 2) create a small CI harness that simulates dropped-last-chunk behavior.

Sanjay: will add the harness and GH Action. RED-9504. tests will assert no double-charges and KV resumption.

Maria: alerting policy: if partial_chunk_detected > 4/min sustained 2m in prod -> page streaming-bridge. dev/stage lower. alerts should auto-open a prefilled ticket with request/session ids.

Ken: runbook will include the ticket template and exact curl commands for recreating. linking to docs/incident-runbooks after I push.

deploy-bot: staging deploy queued: reconnect-lib v0.10.0 by Sanjay, scheduled 2026-03-27T02:00:00Z.

ops-bot: recurring event created: "Streaming Resilience Bridge" Mon/Wed 30m starting 2026-03-30. Invites sent.

pm-ryan: thanks. we'll reconvene next Tue for rollup. this thread is canonical for owners until we hit 14 clean days. escalate to P0 on any sustained spike.
